total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after all staked tokens are withdrawn
total_supply_zero.checkpoint: before reward notification during empty period

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with no deposits while gauge total supply is zero
empty_period_elapsed.checkpoint: during empty period before new deposits

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add new rewards during the empty period

rewards_claimable.meaning: reward tokens transferred to the contract for the empty period become claimable by users
rewards_claimable.checkpoint: after new deposits and interactions following the empty period

rewards_unclaimable.meaning: reward tokens transferred to the contract for the empty period remain unaccrued and unclaimable by users even after new deposits and interactions
rewards_unclaimable.checkpoint: after new deposits and interactions following the empty period

assumptions: Reward tokens are transferred to the gauge contract for the empty period via notifyRewardAmount.
New deposits and user interactions occur after the empty period.
No attacker is required; harm arises from normal withdrawals and reward notifications.

unresolved.description: Report says notifyRewardAmount 'may be called' during the empty period; whether it is actually called is not established.
Exact stuck reward amounts and precise reward duration beyond 'one week' are not specified.

limitations: Formalizes only v_rewards_stuck; other impacts (v_full_epoch_stuck, v_protocol_fund_loss) are handled in separate passes.
Claimability is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the observable outcome without a numeric accrual formula.
The empty-period reward notification is treated as a potential scenario per the report's 'may be called' wording.
